# Real-Time Manim Website

> Product site + wiki for real-time-manim (Vulkan-accelerated manim). The AGENT wiki — for AI agents working on this repo, not for humans — is `wiki/agent/`.

## For agents
- [Agent wiki](wiki/agent/README.md): dense, greppable agent-facing reference. Use this, not the human wiki.
- [Architecture / session log](docs/architecture.md): what has been done, session by session.
